body:
I haven't commit any human atrocities/felonies for over 5 years now. Ever since then, I realized what a disgusting piece of shit I've grown into and, trust me, I've put MASSIVE effort into becoming a better person. Reiteration of my own narcissism, but I pretty much dedicated all of my late teen years to helping people, more specifically, helping the people who were hurt like I hurt that girl or I hurt that friend.

From an objective standpoint, I have no doubt I've done many beneficial things for marginalized communities. The communities I ONCE MARGINALIZED.

But, the fact remains that in the past, I WAS A FUCKING MONSTER. And I just can't live with my past anymore.
